Appearance.Position.name: Position
Appearance.Position.description: Where the island should appear on your screen.

Appearance.TargetMonitor.name: Target Monitor
Appearance.TargetMonitor.description: Select the screen to display the island. If a display isn't found, it safely falls back to the Primary Monitor.

Appearance.Displays.name: Displays
Appearance.Displays.description: single = only the Target Monitor; all = the island on the Target Monitor plus a mirror on every other display.

Appearance.MirrorPosition.name: Mirror position
Appearance.MirrorPosition.description: Where mirrors sit on the other displays (same = like the main island).

Appearance.DisplayPositions.name: Per-display positions
Appearance.DisplayPositions.description: Optional overrides by display number, e.g. 2=bottom-center;3=top-left

Appearance.OffsetX.name: Offset X
Appearance.OffsetX.description: Adjust the horizontal position (in pixels). Positive values move it right, negative values move it left.

Appearance.OffsetY.name: Offset Y
Appearance.OffsetY.description: Adjust the vertical position (in pixels). Positive values move it down, negative values move it up. Applies to every state unless the separate expanded offset below is turned on, in which case this becomes the collapsed/idle offset.

Appearance.SeparateExpandedOffsetY.name: Use a separate Offset Y when expanded
Appearance.SeparateExpandedOffsetY.description: Lets the island sit at one height while collapsed and a different one while expanded. Useful for tucking the idle pill up near the screen edge while keeping the expanded dashboard somewhere comfortable to interact with.

Appearance.OffsetYExpanded.name: Offset Y (expanded)
Appearance.OffsetYExpanded.description: Vertical position in pixels while the island is expanded. Only used when the separate expanded offset above is on. The island eases between this and Offset Y as it expands and collapses, so the two never snap.

Appearance.BorderMergedMode.name: Border-Merged Mode
Appearance.BorderMergedMode.description: Attach the island flush to the top edge of the monitor without a floating gap.

Appearance.ShapeStyle.name: Island Shape Style
Appearance.ShapeStyle.description: Change the overall shape of the island (Pill, Windows 11, or macOS Notch).

Appearance.ProgressStyle.name: Progress bar style
Appearance.ProgressStyle.description: Look of the song progress bar in the expanded media player. Wavy and Squiggle animate while music is playing and flatten when paused.

options.label: Bar (thick bar with a line thumb)

Appearance.SpectrumStyle.name: Audio spectrum style
Appearance.SpectrumStyle.description: Look of the live audio visualizer next to the album art (collapsed pill and expanded player). Pulse Orb, Plasma Thread and Peak Matrix use a real frequency analysis of the system audio, and each plays its own animation when the track changes.

Appearance.SizeScale.name: Size scale
Appearance.SizeScale.description: Makes the entire island and its contents larger or smaller.

Appearance.AutoDpiScale.name: Auto DPI scaling
Appearance.AutoDpiScale.description: Automatically scales the island to match your monitor's DPI. Recommended for 4K screens.

Behavior.AlwaysOnTop.name: Always on top
Behavior.AlwaysOnTop.description: Keeps the island above all other windows. Turn this off if it blocks other apps.

Behavior.ExpandOnHover.name: Expand on hover
Behavior.ExpandOnHover.description: Expand the island automatically when hovered. If disabled, click to expand.

Behavior.AutoHideIdleSeconds.name: Auto-hide island (all states)
Behavior.AutoHideIdleSeconds.description: Hide the island (including idle, media, and other states) after this many seconds of inactivity. 0 to disable.

Behavior.AutoHideFullscreen.name: Hide on full screen
Behavior.AutoHideFullscreen.description: Automatically hide the island when playing a video or app in full screen mode.

Behavior.UnhideOnHover.name: Unhide on hover
Behavior.UnhideOnHover.description: Allow the hidden island to reappear when you hover your mouse over it.

Animations.TargetFPS.name: Refresh rate / FPS
Animations.TargetFPS.description: Set the animation frame rate. Choose Auto to dynamically match your active monitor's refresh rate (up to 360Hz/500Hz), or select a fixed FPS.

Animations.AnimationStyle.name: Animation bounciness / style
Animations.AnimationStyle.description: Control the spring physics and feel of the animation.

Animations.AnimationSpeed.name: Animation speed
Animations.AnimationSpeed.description: How fast the island expands and collapses.

Animations.ExpandedMediaTransitions.name: Expanded player transitions
Animations.ExpandedMediaTransitions.description: Animate the hover player when the song changes or you press a control - title, artist and album text, the cover flip, and the previous / next / play-pause buttons. Turn off to make them change instantly.

Animations.PillCoverSpin.name: Pill cover spin
Animations.PillCoverSpin.description: Spin the album cover in the collapsed pill when the song changes. Turn off to swap the cover instantly.

Themes.ThemePreset.name: Theme preset
Themes.ThemePreset.description: Select a curated color theme, or choose Custom to use your own hex colors below.

Themes.PillOpacity.name: Pill transparency
Themes.PillOpacity.description: 35 to 100. Lower values make the island more see-through.

Themes.TintIntensity.name: Background tint intensity
Themes.TintIntensity.description: 0 to 100. Controls how dark the background tint behind the island is.

Themes.BackdropMaterial.name: Backdrop material (real Windows blur)
Themes.BackdropMaterial.description: Paints genuine Windows blur or acrylic behind the island so your desktop and windows show through it, using the same effect the system uses for its own surfaces. Acrylic adds Windows' frosted grain and a tint of your background colour (see Acrylic tint strength). Requires Windows 10 1803 or newer, and Windows' Transparency effects must be turned ON (Settings > Personalization > Colors > Transparency effects, or on Windows 11 also Settings > Accessibility > Visual effects). If it is off, or Battery saver is on, you will only see a flat tint with no blur. When this is on, use Backdrop fill opacity below to control how much of the blur comes through.

Themes.BackdropFillOpacity.name: Backdrop fill opacity
Themes.BackdropFillOpacity.description: 0 to 100. Only used when a Backdrop material is enabled. How opaque the island's own background stays on top of the blur - lower values let more of the blurred desktop through. Has no effect when the backdrop is Off.

Themes.BackdropTint.name: Acrylic tint strength
Themes.BackdropTint.description: 0 to 100. How strongly your background colour tints the backdrop. Acrylic uses the full strength; Blur uses a lighter wash of the same colour so the desktop stays readable.

Themes.MaterialDepth.name: Depth shading
Themes.MaterialDepth.description: Adds soft downward shading and the accent wash so the island has depth instead of looking like one flat fill. No edge highlights or rim lighting are involved. Turn off for a completely flat look.

Themes.DropShadow.name: Soft drop shadow
Themes.DropShadow.description: Casts a soft shadow beneath the island to lift it off the desktop.

Themes.AccentBloom.name: Accent bloom intensity
Themes.AccentBloom.description: 0 to 200. Strength of the soft accent-coloured wash bleeding in from the top of the island. Driven by album art when the accent mode is Auto. Set to 0 to remove it.

Themes.TextScale.name: Text size
Themes.TextScale.description: 70 to 160. Scales all island text independently of the overall Size scale, so you can keep the island compact while making the clock and labels easier to read.

Themes.AccentColorMode.name: Accent color mode
Themes.AccentColorMode.description: How the glowing accent color is chosen. Auto extracts it from album art.

Themes.CustomAccentHex.name: Custom accent hex
Themes.CustomAccentHex.description: The hex color to use when the accent mode is set to Custom.

Themes.CalendarAccent.name: Calendar accent color
Themes.CalendarAccent.description: Accent color for the calendar's month name and today's marker. Default uses the island's accent color mode; System always uses the Windows accent.

Themes.ClockAccentGlow.name: Show clock background circle/glow
Themes.ClockAccentGlow.description: Display the soft accent circle/glow behind the time in the expanded clock view. Turn off for a clean, minimal clock without background glow.

Themes.FontFamily.name: Font family
Themes.FontFamily.description: Custom font family for island text (e.g. Segoe UI, Arial, Aptos, Consolas). Leave empty for system default.

Themes.ContourBorderMode.name: Contour border
Themes.ContourBorderMode.description: Choose the island's border style. Default uses the theme's matching border, Auto extracts the border color from album art, and Borderless removes all outer border outlines.

Themes.ContourBorderHex.name: Contour border hex color
Themes.ContourBorderHex.description: Hex color for the island contour stroke. Changing it from the default overrides the selected Theme preset; restore the default to go back to the preset.

Themes.PillBgColor.name: Pill background color
Themes.PillBgColor.description: Hex color for the island background. Accepts 3, 4, 6 or 8 hex digits, so use the 8-digit RRGGBBAA form for a translucent background (for example 0D0D0FB0) while keeping the text and icons opaque. Changing it from the default overrides the selected Theme preset; restore the default to go back to the preset.

Themes.TextPrimaryColor.name: Primary text color
Themes.TextPrimaryColor.description: Accessible hex color for titles and main text. Changing it from the default overrides the selected Theme preset; restore the default to go back to the preset.

Themes.TextSecondaryColor.name: Secondary text color
Themes.TextSecondaryColor.description: Accessible hex color for artist names and muted labels. Changing it from the default overrides the selected Theme preset; restore the default to go back to the preset.

Indicators.PrivacyDots.name: Show privacy indicators (Mic & Camera)
Indicators.PrivacyDots.description: Master toggle to display the iOS-style privacy dots when microphone or camera is in use.

Indicators.PrivacyDotsMic.name: Show microphone indicator (Orange dot)
Indicators.PrivacyDotsMic.description: Show the orange dot when microphone is in use. Turn off if background apps (like Discord/OBS) keep it permanently active.

Indicators.PrivacyDotsMicHex.name: Microphone dot color
Indicators.PrivacyDotsMicHex.description: Custom hex color for microphone privacy indicator.

Indicators.PrivacyDotsCam.name: Show camera indicator (Green dot)
Indicators.PrivacyDotsCam.description: Show the green dot when webcam is in use.

Indicators.PrivacyDotsCamHex.name: Camera dot color
Indicators.PrivacyDotsCamHex.description: Custom hex color for camera privacy indicator.

Modules.Media.name: Media module
Modules.Media.description: Shows album art, song info, and playback controls when music is playing.

Modules.MediaAutoExpand.name: Auto-expand on track change
Modules.MediaAutoExpand.description: Automatically expand the island when a new song or video starts playing. If disabled, album art updates smoothly in the collapsed pill without unprompted expansion.

Modules.CollapsedTitle.name: Song title in the collapsed pill
Modules.CollapsedTitle.description: While music plays, the collapsed pill shows the song title next to the cover. Right-click the island and pick "Show lyrics on collapsed island" to show synced lyrics there instead.

Modules.MediaPillClock.name: Show clock in the collapsed media pill
Modules.MediaPillClock.description: While media is playing, the collapsed pill also shows the current time on the left, separated from the album cover by a thin divider. Hovering still opens the normal player. Uses the same 12h/24h and seconds options as the clock below. Off by default.

Modules.Volume.name: Volume slider flyout
Modules.Volume.description: Shows a volume slider banner on the island when adjusting system volume. Disable if you prefer the default Windows volume flyout.

Modules.Brightness.name: Brightness slider flyout
Modules.Brightness.description: Shows a brightness slider banner on the island when you change the screen brightness. Works with a laptop's built-in display. Disable if you prefer the default Windows brightness flyout.

Modules.CapsLock.name: Caps Lock module
Modules.CapsLock.description: Shows an indicator when Caps Lock or Num Lock state changes.

Modules.Battery.name: Battery module
Modules.Battery.description: Shows an alert when your laptop battery is running low.

Modules.BluetoothIndicator.name: Bluetooth connect/disconnect indicator
Modules.BluetoothIndicator.description: Shows a card with the device name, category icon, and battery level (if available) when a Bluetooth device connects or disconnects.

Modules.BluetoothShowBattery.name: Show Bluetooth battery level
Modules.BluetoothShowBattery.description: Reads battery level over BLE GATT when the device supports it. Not all classic Bluetooth devices report battery this way — when unavailable, only a Connected/Disconnected label is shown.

Modules.Progress.name: Progress module
Modules.Progress.description: Shows a progress ring around the island for downloads or file copies.

Modules.TimerModule.name: Focus Timer module
Modules.TimerModule.description: Enables a Pomodoro-style focus/break timer, startable from the island's right-click menu.

Modules.Clipboard.name: Clipboard module
Modules.Clipboard.description: Shows a quick preview of the text or images you just copied.

Modules.StatusCountdownProgress.name: Status countdown progress bar
Modules.StatusCountdownProgress.description: Shows a subtle countdown progress bar at the bottom of temporary status alert cards (such as Clipboard, Notifications, and Device alerts). Disabled by default.

Modules.DoNotDisturbIndicator.name: Do Not Disturb status alert
Modules.DoNotDisturbIndicator.description: Shows a status alert card when Do Not Disturb is toggled in the Windows notification panel.

Modules.NotificationRespectDnD.name: Notifications respect Do Not Disturb
Modules.NotificationRespectDnD.description: Suppresses Dynamic Island notification alerts when Windows Do Not Disturb is active.

Modules.HardwareMonitorModule.name: Include Hardware Monitor in scroll loop
Modules.HardwareMonitorModule.description: Add CPU, GPU, RAM, FPS and Network stats card to mouse-wheel scroll loop.

Modules.ConnectivityModule.name: Include Connectivity in scroll loop
Modules.ConnectivityModule.description: Add a Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and Do Not Disturb status card to the mouse-wheel scroll loop. Click a card to open its Windows settings.

Modules.GameOverlay.name: Enable game overlay mode
Modules.GameOverlay.description: Replaces the clock with live stats like FPS, CPU, and RAM usage.

Modules.ShowMetricText.name: Show labels in metric chips
Modules.ShowMetricText.description: Adds text labels (like "CPU") inside the game overlay bars.

Modules.Weather.name: Weather module
Modules.Weather.description: Shows the weather on the right side of the pill. Turn off to only show the clock.

Modules.WeatherCity.name: Weather City (Optional)
Modules.WeatherCity.description: Enter your city (e.g. London). Leave blank to use auto IP geolocation.

Modules.WeatherFahrenheit.name: Use Fahrenheit
Modules.WeatherFahrenheit.description: Display weather temperature and wind speed in imperial units.

Modules.MediaTabLyrics.name: Lyrics in the media tab
Modules.MediaTabLyrics.description: Adds a lyrics button to the media player controls to toggle an immersive lyrics view over the media tab. Can also be toggled from the right-click menu.

Modules.Lyrics.name: Lyrics module
Modules.Lyrics.description: Shows synced lyrics for the current track (fetched from LRCLIB, a free open-source lyrics database) while the island is expanded. Scroll to the Lyrics tab to view them.

Modules.LyricsVisualizer.name: Show visualizer in Lyrics tab
Modules.LyricsVisualizer.description: Shows a small live audio waveform next to the Lyrics title while a track is playing.

Modules.KaraokeLyrics.name: Karaoke-style glow
Modules.KaraokeLyrics.description: Lights up the active lyric line progressively, left to right, in sync with the song.

Modules.KaraokeLetterGlow.name: Karaoke letter glow
Modules.KaraokeLetterGlow.description: As the karaoke light sweeps across the line, letters near the wipe boundary softly glow, then fade out behind it.

Modules.LyricsOffsetMs.name: Lyrics sync offset - speakers / wired (ms)
Modules.LyricsOffsetMs.description: Fine-tunes lyric timing in milliseconds (-3000 to 3000, 1 ms steps). Positive = lyrics appear EARLIER, negative = LATER. Raise it if lyrics feel late, lower it if they feel early. Applies to every lyric view (Lyrics tab, collapsed pill, media-tab panel and the karaoke wipe). This value is used whenever the default audio output is NOT a Bluetooth device. You can also nudge it from the right-click menu under Lyrics sync.

Modules.LyricsOffsetBluetoothMs.name: Lyrics sync offset - Bluetooth output (ms)
Modules.LyricsOffsetBluetoothMs.description: Same as above (-3000 to 3000 ms, positive = EARLIER, negative = LATER), but used automatically while the default audio output is a Bluetooth device. Bluetooth adds latency, so lyrics usually need to be shifted LATER (a negative value) here. The island switches between the two values by itself when the output changes.

Modules.LyricsNeighborLinesVisible.name: Show neighboring lyric lines clearly
Modules.LyricsNeighborLinesVisible.description: By default the lines above and below the active line are only a faint ghost. Turn this on to make them clearly readable.

Modules.LyricsCache.name: Lyrics cache (disk)
Modules.LyricsCache.description: Instant lyrics, less load on LRCLIB, tiny disk use, clearable anytime. Stored in the mod's storage folder. Turn off to stop all lyrics disk reads and writes.

Modules.LyricsCacheMaxMB.name: Lyrics cache size limit
Modules.LyricsCacheMaxMB.description: Least recently used files are deleted once the cache grows past this. Off disables the disk cache.

Modules.Language.name: Language
Modules.Language.description: Language for the island's own text labels. Auto follows your Windows display language.

Modules.ClockFormat.name: Clock format
Modules.ClockFormat.description: Choose 12-hour or 24-hour time, or follow your Windows locale setting.

Modules.ShowSeconds.name: Show seconds on the clock
Modules.ShowSeconds.description: Include seconds in the expanded clock. Costs a little more CPU because the clock then redraws every second.

Modules.DateFormat.name: Custom date format
Modules.DateFormat.description: Custom date pattern for the idle dashboard. Leave empty to follow your Windows locale. Supports yyyy (year), MM / M (month), dd / d (day), MMM (short month name), MMMM (full month name), ddd / dddd (weekday). Any other characters are printed as-is, so CJK formats like yyyy年MM月dd日 work.

Modules.DateFirst.name: Show date above the time
Modules.DateFirst.description: Swap the idle dashboard so the date is the headline and the time sits beneath it.

Modules.FirstDayOfWeek.name: First day of the week
Modules.FirstDayOfWeek.description: Which weekday the calendar grid starts on. Auto follows your Windows regional format.

Modules.QuickLookup.name: Quick Lookup (hotkey)
Modules.QuickLookup.description: Press the Ask Bun hotkey (set on the Assistant & agents page) to open a search box on the island. Type a word or short phrase and press Enter, or pick your clipboard text or a recent lookup. Nothing is sent anywhere until you submit a search; searches go to en.wiktionary.org and en.wikipedia.org (and api.dictionaryapi.dev as a backup dictionary). Recent lookups are kept in memory only and cleared when the mod restarts.

Modules.FileTrayModule.name: File Tray (drag & drop shelf)
Modules.FileTrayModule.description: Adds a File Tray card to the scroll loop. Drag files onto the island to park them there, then click to open one, or use the right-click menu to clear the shelf. Files are only referenced, never copied or moved.

Modules.FileTrayMaxItems.name: File Tray capacity
Modules.FileTrayMaxItems.description: 1 to 25. How many files the shelf keeps before the oldest one drops off.

Modules.FileTrayPersist.name: File Tray remembers items (disk)
Modules.FileTrayPersist.description: Keeps the tray's contents across restarts, in the mod's storage folder. Only file paths and pasted text snippets are stored, never copies of your files. Turn off to stop all disk reads and writes and delete the saved list.

Modules.MediaExpandBlocklist.name: Never auto-expand for these apps
Modules.MediaExpandBlocklist.description: Comma-separated list of app or site names that should never make the island expand on a track change, while still updating quietly in the collapsed pill. Matched loosely against the media source and title, for example: chrome, tiktok, youtube.

Modules.GameOverlayShowFps.name: Game overlay - show FPS
Modules.GameOverlayShowFps.description: Include the frame rate in the game overlay strip.

Modules.GameOverlayShowCpu.name: Game overlay - show CPU
Modules.GameOverlayShowCpu.description: Include CPU utilization in the game overlay strip.

Modules.GameOverlayShowGpu.name: Game overlay - show GPU
Modules.GameOverlayShowGpu.description: Include GPU utilization in the game overlay strip.

Modules.GameOverlayShowRam.name: Game overlay - show RAM
Modules.GameOverlayShowRam.description: Include memory usage in the game overlay strip.

Modules.GameOverlayShowDisk.name: Game overlay - show disk
Modules.GameOverlayShowDisk.description: Include disk usage in the game overlay strip.

Modules.GameOverlayCompact.name: Game overlay - compact size
Modules.GameOverlayCompact.description: Shrink the game overlay to a narrow strip that fits neatly inside the taskbar area.

Shortcuts.HideShowHotkeyEnabled.name: Enable hide/show hotkey
Shortcuts.HideShowHotkeyEnabled.description: Toggle the island's visibility instantly with a keyboard shortcut. The hotkey is the only way to bring a hidden island back, so leave this on unless you're comfortable re-enabling it from settings.ini.

Shortcuts.HideShowModifiers.name: Hotkey modifiers
Shortcuts.HideShowModifiers.description: Modifier keys combined with the letter/number key below.

Shortcuts.HideShowKey.name: Hotkey letter/number key
Shortcuts.HideShowKey.description: A single A-Z or 0-9 key combined with the modifiers above. Falls back to "D" if left blank or invalid.

Shortcuts.LookupModifiers.name: Quick Lookup hotkey modifiers
Shortcuts.LookupModifiers.description: Modifier keys combined with the Quick Lookup key below.

Shortcuts.LookupKey.name: Quick Lookup hotkey key
Shortcuts.LookupKey.description: Type Space, or a single A-Z or 0-9 key. Falls back to Space if left blank or invalid. Bunbun defaults to B (Ctrl+Alt+B, "Ask Bun"): Ctrl+Alt+Space is taken by the Claude desktop app.

Bunbun.Agents.name: Coding agents
Bunbun.Agents.description: Show Claude Code, Antigravity, Cursor and VS Code / Copilot sessions (and any agent that runs the hook command) and approval cards on the island.

Bunbun.ShellApprovals.name: Ask before shell commands
Bunbun.ShellApprovals.description: Cursor and Antigravity don't tell Bunbun when they would ask for permission, so Bunbun can instead pause every shell command for an Allow / Deny card on the island. Claude Code and Copilot always get cards when they would ask.

Bunbun.Mascot.name: Bun mascot
Bunbun.Mascot.description: Show your mascot on agent pills, approval cards and the Ask Bun box.

Bunbun.AmbientFps.name: Ambient frame rate
Bunbun.AmbientFps.description: Frame rate for continuously moving content (waveform, marquees) while the island is not resizing. Resizing always uses the full refresh rate.

Bunbun.MascotOnIsland.name: Mascot on the island
Bunbun.MascotOnIsland.description: Show the mascot beside the clock and the music pill. With music playing it puts on headphones and vibes.

Bunbun.MascotDnd.name: Mascot do not disturb
Bunbun.MascotDnd.description: The mascot settles in with its favourite snack and stops reacting. Independent of Windows' Do Not Disturb. Ask Bun "dnd on" or "dnd off" to switch it.

Bunbun.Character.name: Mascot character
Bunbun.Character.description: bunny, cat, dog, fox, panda, robot, spiderman, doom, or custom:<folder> for a skin pack in %APPDATA%\Bunbun\mascots

Bunbun.MascotColor.name: Mascot colour
Bunbun.MascotColor.description: Per-mascot colours, e.g. bunny=#F4B6C8;cat=#5B5868. A mascot without an entry keeps its own colour. Spidey, Doom and skin packs can't be recoloured.

Bunbun.Assistant.name: Ask Bun
Bunbun.Assistant.description: The Quick Lookup box (Ctrl+Alt+B) becomes Bun's command line - open apps and settings, media and volume, timers, web search, quick PC facts, math. Fully local. Type "define <word>" or "wiki <topic>" for the dictionary.
